_comment: Craft-show mode. enabled=true opens every tile below without a Patreon login (after the phone visits /show/) and adds the 'Order this design' button inside those modelers. Prices are CAD. Flip enabled to false and push after the show.
title: Personalized 3D prints
tagline: Create your own, starting at $7. Choose a product, add your name and colours, preview it in 3D, and pay at our booth.
madeToOrder: Made to order: printed after the show.

production._comment: Wording shown to customers. dayType: 'business' or 'calendar'. bulkThreshold: quantity from which the bulk wording applies, or null to never show it.
production.regular: Regular custom orders: 3 to 5 business days after payment.
production.bulk: Bulk orders: at least 7 to 10 business days, depending on quantity.
production.shipping: Pickup or shipping available. Shipping costs are quoted separately.

payNote: Show your order number at our booth to pay (cash, e-transfer or card). Production starts after payment and a final check of your design.

tax._comment: No tax is added by the site. Prices are shown as charged. Change to 'included' or add rates only after confirming with the accountant.

tiles.name: Pop Socket Topper
tiles.blurb: Puffy bubble letters that glue onto a pop socket. Up to three lines, your colours.
tiles.hint: Type 1, 2 or 3 lines of text, pick a font and colours, then order.

tiles.name: Grinch Ornament
tiles.blurb: Nine Grinch poses with your name in bubble letters. Four colours.
tiles.hint: Pick a pose, type the name, choose the four colours, then order.

tiles.name: Dumpling Ornament
tiles.blurb: A cute dumpling in a bamboo steamer with a name and an accessory.
tiles.hint: Type the name, pick an accessory and colours, then order.

tiles.name: Snowflake Name Ornament
tiles.blurb: Your name in chunky letters across a snowflake. Pick the snowflake, letter and backing colours.
tiles.hint: Type the name, pick the snowflake style and the three colours, then order.

tiles.name: Phone Stand Keychain
tiles.blurb: A keychain that flips open into a phone stand, with your name on the side.
tiles.hint: Type the name for the side, pick colours, then order.
